compared_objects.model: MiMo-V2.5-Pro (FP8 block-scale checkpoint, hybrid SWA + GQA attention, 384-expert MoE)
compared_objects.hardware: Azure ND MI300X v5 VM: 8x AMD Instinct MI300X (gfx942, 304 CUs, 192 GB HBM3 each), 8x InfiniBand ports
compared_objects.serving_engine: SGLang (sammysun0711/sglang fork) with AITER, Composable Kernel and FlyDSL kernels
compared_objects.comparison_rule: Every percentage on the reader page compares MI300X with MI300X. No other accelerator is compared.

stage-before-moe-table.topology: 1P1D: prefill server TP8 on VM A, decode server TP8 on VM B, KV transfer over Mooncake RDMA on 8 IB ports, router and benchmark client on VM A
stage-before-moe-table.server_flags: --tp-size 8 --attention-backend aiter --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --page-size 32 --chunked-prefill-size 32768 --context-length 262144 --max-running-requests 128 --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --disable-radix-cache --disable-overlap-schedule --speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 --enable-multi-layer-eagle; the prefill server adds --disable-cuda-graph --disaggregation-mode prefill, the decode server --disaggregation-mode decode, both --disaggregation-transfer-backend mooncake
stage-before-moe-table.server_env: both servers: SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 SGLANG_USE_AITER_CK_BLOCKSCALE_BPRESHUFFLE=1 SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=3 SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_METHOD=match-expected; decode server also SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_VERIFY=1

script_sha256.decode_launch: file hash not captured on the decode VM; its captured environment lines match the decode script of stage-after-moe-table

inherited_env.source: sorted environment captured inside the prefill container during the run
inherited_env.origin: ENV of the rocm/sgl-dev base image; the launch scripts do not set it

runtime.sglang: same container image as stage-before-moe-table (commit not re-captured)

inherited_env.origin: same container image and launch scripts as stage-before-moe-table

ab-64k-bs16.topology: 1 VM, TP8, one server doing both prefill and decode (no PD), exact 64K input token IDs, 1K server-accounted output, 16 requests in flight, fixed MTP acceptance of 3 draft tokens

runtime.image: single-VM image derived from the stage-after-moe-table runtime
runtime.kv_pool: --mem-fraction-static 0.95 so that sixteen 64K-context requests fit (full-attention KV pool 1,442,464 tokens)

ab-64k-bs16.controlled: same host, running container, immutable image, model, benchmark command, TP8 topology, KV-pool setting, server flags and transition rule; two fresh-service repetitions per arm, run back-to-back
ab-64k-bs16.metric: steady-state scheduler generation throughput (tok/s) at batch 16; the first full-batch sample of each run is a transition sample and is excluded

baseline-pd-client.topology: 1P1D: prefill server TP8 on one VM, decode server TP8 on a second VM, Mooncake KV transfer over one InfiniBand port, router in front
baseline-pd-client.runtime: SGLang v0.5.11 baseline build; prefill with --attention-backend aiter; decode with Triton attention; Triton W8A8 FP8 GEMM; default KV cache dtype (no --kv-cache-dtype); no speculative decoding
baseline-pd-client.client: custom asyncio client of the baseline test harness (p50 latency, completion count and token throughput per run), not sglang.bench_serving
baseline-pd-client.graph_capture_ab: same session and servers; the only change is removing --disable-cuda-graph from the decode server so that decode steps replay as captured HIP graphs
notes: Requests stopped at about 340 of the 1,024 requested output tokens in both graph arms, so their throughput compares with each other, not with bench_serving runs.

baseline-pd-summary.topology: 1P1D on two VMs, same layout as baseline-pd-client
baseline-pd-summary.runtime: SGLang v0.5.11 baseline build, Triton attention on both servers, Triton W8A8 FP8 GEMM, no speculative decoding, decode graph capture on
baseline-pd-summary.decode_workload: 16K input / 1K output, random dataset, client concurrency 32-96
notes: The single-VM prefill range in the same report ends at 128K = 6,915 tok/s (single stream, TP8, Triton attention).

runtime.aiter: an earlier AITER build (no tuned fused-MoE table)

actual-acceptance.server_env: SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 SGLANG_USE_AITER_CK_BLOCKSCALE_BPRESHUFFLE=1 SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2=1; no SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_* variable and no SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_VERIFY, so MTP acceptance is whatever the draft model achieves on random prompts

context-matrix.topology: same as stage-before-moe-table (1P1D, one TP8 server per VM)
context-matrix.runtime: image built from the stage-after-moe-table runtime (sglang 2f9b9aedf, aiter 00e94abf1 with the tuned fused-MoE table); --context-length 262151, --chunked-prefill-size 16384 on the decode server; decode with MTP at a fixed acceptance of 3
context-matrix.prefill_workload: random prompts, output 1, 16 requests per point; 256K points use exact token IDs
context-matrix.decode_workload: random prompts, 1K output; 8K and 64K at client concurrency 16-128, 128K-256K at 1-32; the batch is read from the decode server's #running-req
notes: The 256K prefill point at concurrency 4 was rejected: two service lifecycles hit GPU memory faults, so no value is reported.
The 256K decode row uses 261,120 input tokens so that input plus 1,024 output tokens fits the 262,151-token context.

prefill-replicas.topology: two VMs, each running one ordinary TP8 server (no PD mode), behind one sglang_router with --policy round_robin; no cross-node collective
prefill-replicas.runtime: same image as context-matrix; --context-length 262151 --chunked-prefill-size 32768 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --page-size 32, EAGLE MTP at a fixed acceptance of 3
prefill-replicas.workload: random prompts, output 1; two replicas: 32 requests per point at client concurrency 1-16 (256K: 1-8); single-server reference: the 1P1D prefill server of the same series, 16 requests per point

accuracy-subset.topology: two VMs, each running one independent TP8 server (prefill and decode in one server); the benchmarks were split across them

runtime.aiter: 00e94abf1 with the tuned fused-MoE table (hash-checked before start)

accuracy-subset.server_flags: --tp-size 8 --attention-backend aiter --quantization fp8 --page-size 1 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --max-running-requests 128 --context-length 1048576 --speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 --enable-multi-layer-eagle --reasoning-parser qwen3; no --kv-cache-dtype, so the KV cache stays at the model's default precision
accuracy-subset.server_env: SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 SGLANG_USE_AITER_CK_BLOCKSCALE_BPRESHUFFLE=1 SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2=1; SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_* unset and checked unset before start, so MTP runs at the acceptance the draft model achieves
accuracy-subset.not_recorded: ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION was not set by the launcher and the captured environment lists SGLANG_ variables only, so the effective Quick Reduce setting (the base image exports INT8) is not recorded
